mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a clear night at Harriet Park with a current temperature of 65 degrees under a New Moon.

In city news, the Verona Common Council has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to steer our local growth. Additionally, the city has been maintaining a strong financial position with a Moody's Aa1 rating.

There is plenty to enjoy this week. We have live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Looking ahead to next week, you can catch trivia at various locations and the Farmer's Market on Tuesday.

The Verona Police Department reported that on October 3, an officer located a subject during a traffic stop who was found to be in possession of a stolen firearm and was subsequently taken into custody.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Caramel Cashew. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
